text:
Our field sales team piloted an AI note-taker for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

Time saved was real. Reps cut post-call admin from about 25 minutes to under 10. That meant more selling, less typing in the parking lot.

But the bigger win was CRM quality. Next steps and stakeholders actually got logged, because nobody had to remember them at 6 p.m.

What surprised us: customers cared about consent. Reps who asked up front, in one sentence, saw almost no pushback. Reps who skipped it lost trust fast.

What didn't work: raw transcripts. Nobody read them. Short, structured summaries did.

Our takeaway: the tool matters less than the habits around it.

What would you test next?
